import json,collections
cards=[json.loads(s) for s in open('items.jsonl')]
rows=[json.loads(s) for s in open('answers.jsonl')]
rows[18]['detail']='ΚΛΕΑΡΙΑ → ΚΑΙΕΔΡΙ; ornament → 1000000000000000'
rows[18]['where'][0]['printed']='ΚΛΕΑΡΙΑ'
rows[46]['where']=[{'label':'','printed':'από 1/1/1990 έγινε αύξηση του μετοχικού κεφαλαίου της εταιρίας'}, {'label':'','printed':'στο προσάρτημα.'}]
rows[55]['errors']=['wrong_mark','merged_two_lines']
rows[55]['detail']='ἐριστικὴ → ἐριστική'
# The main row in card 43 is complete; neighbouring rows are cut, not the target.
rows[42]['owner_crop']['turned_or_clipped']='yes'
with open('answers.jsonl','w') as f:
 for r in rows: f.write(json.dumps(r,ensure_ascii=False)+'\n')
assert len(cards)==len(rows)
assert [r['card_id'] for r in rows]==[c['card_id'] for c in cards]
assert len(set(r['card_id'] for r in rows))==len(rows)
for r in rows:
 assert r['letters'] in ['y','n','u']
 assert r['marks'] in ['y','n','na']
 assert r['crop_ok'] in ['y','n']
 assert len(r['owner_crop'])==5 and all(x in ['yes','no','uncertain'] for x in r['owner_crop'].values())
 assert isinstance(r['where'],list)
 for w in r['where']: assert set(w)=={'label','printed'} and all(isinstance(v,str) for v in w.values())
print('Count and order validated:',len(rows))
for k in ['letters','marks','crop_ok']: print(k,dict(collections.Counter(r[k] for r in rows)))
print('Top errors:',collections.Counter(e for r in rows for e in r['errors']).most_common(3))
